== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings|The [[Luminian Order]] is a highly organized and disciplined religious and paramilitary organization, founded by [[Loreli]], the Daughter of the Emperor. The group is characterized by its devotion to an [[Unknown God]] and its historical role as both a military force and a source of healing. Members are often recognized by their distinctive attire: [[Pilgrims]] typically wear all-white clothing and silver medallions featuring the [[White Sun]], while Knights wear silver armor. The [[Order]]'s headquarters is located at [[Hightower]], a fortified complex near the Capital that features a massive glass orb atop a [[stone tower]] which serves as a beacon of light. This headquarters is noted for its atmosphere of peace and tranquility, built up through centuries of devotion. The [[Order]]'s primary functions include providing security, acting as healers, and opposing the influence of [[Great Elders]]. While they have historically led humanity into war, they have also been known to preach peace and provide auxiliary support to other groups like the [[Independent Guilds]]. Their healing capabilities are highly regarded, though for many [[Pilgrims]], these powers must be earned through years of service and medical training rather than being innate. The [[Order]] maintains a complex relationship with other factions, such as the [[Blackwatch]] and the [[Consultants]], often engaging in rivalry or strategic alliances. Their ideology involves a strong opposition to Elder worship and the eradication of [[Elderspawn]], though some members may experience religious zeal or mental instability through the process of [[Awakening]] their sacred medallions.}}

== Of Darkness and Dawn ==
{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-02-of-darkness-and-dawn|The Luminians suffered the loss of their members known as 'the others' on the night of the Emperor's death. While they are a group to whom [[Shera]] can dispatch messengers during emergencies, their history is linked to assassination through the Guild of Magisters{{!}}Magister's Guild assassins, who were formerly part of the group. Following this loss, Mekendi Maxeus{{!}}Maxeus's own assassins underwent training, and the Luminians became known for their polite and official manner of speech. Currently, Luminian [[Pilgrims]] are present within the palace as the group works to cleanse the Capital of [[Elderspawn]]. Although they treated [[Benji]] and his companions well, they did not view them as family, and their devout members remain active in various capacities.}}

== Of Kings and Killers ==
{{spoiler|book=ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers|Headquartered in [[Rainworth]], the Luminians are an established order that dedicates its study to the [[Elders]]. This group maintains a watchful presence as guards of the [[Rose Tower]] and possesses knowledge regarding the crown. Their specialized [[Pilgrims]] are highly regarded experts known for their profound healing abilities. These medicinal skills become vital when a Luminian is required to treat [[Calder]].}}

<div class="wv-facts mw-collapsible mw-collapsed"><div class="wv-facts-head mw-collapsible-toggle">Sourced facts <span class="wv-facts-count">6</span></div>
<ul class="wv-fact-list mw-collapsible-content">
<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers|Luminian{{!}}Luminians study [[Elders]].<ref name="ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers-c3">''Of Kings and Killers'', chapter 3</ref>}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers|The Luminian{{!}}Luminians know about the crown.<ref name="ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers-c5">''Of Kings and Killers'', chapter 5</ref>}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers|Luminian{{!}}Luminians guard the [[Rose Tower]].<ref name="ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers-c6">''Of Kings and Killers'', chapter 6</ref>}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers|Luminian{{!}}Luminian Pilgrims are experts recommended for their healing powers.<ref name="ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers-c9">''Of Kings and Killers'', chapter 9</ref>}}</li>

</ul></div>

== Of Killers and Kings ==
{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings|Comprised of silver-armored knights and white-clad [[Pilgrims]], the Luminians are a group of worshippers dedicated to the [[Unknown God]]. While they acknowledge that the [[Great Elders]] might fear unity within their [[Guild]], the [[Pilgrims]] have historically worked to copy the first Beacon. During periods of conflict, the group has been seen clustering behind barriers or hurrying behind Jorin Curse-breaker{{!}}Jorin toward an exit, and they have even fought side-by-side with the [[Blackwatch]]. Throughout these events, [[Loreli]] spent time among them, though a single lone Luminian was once captured and featured in [[Calder]]'s panel.}}

<div class="wv-facts mw-collapsible mw-collapsed"><div class="wv-facts-head mw-collapsible-toggle">Sourced facts <span class="wv-facts-count">9</span></div>

<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings|The Luminian{{!}}Luminians consist of white-clad [[Pilgrims]] and silver-armored knights.<ref name="ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings-c6">''Of Killers and Kings'', chapter 6</ref>}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings|Luminian{{!}}Luminians are a group clustering behind a barrier.<ref name="ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings-c8">''Of Killers and Kings'', chapter 8</ref>}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings|Luminian{{!}}Luminians are a group that hurried behind Jorin Curse-breaker{{!}}Jorin toward an exit.<ref name="ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings-c8" />}}</li>

<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings|The Luminian{{!}}Luminians worship the [[Unknown God]].<ref name="ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings-c17">''Of Killers and Kings'', chapter 17</ref>}}</li>
